Definition: a collection, i.e. (of water) a reservoir
BiblicalUsage: The word is a reservoir, a gathering of waters, and it appears once, when Jerusalem dug a ditch between the walls for the water of the old pool and forgot to look to the Maker who had fashioned it long ago.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the reservoir is the rebuke: they stored the water and forgot the God who sends it.
